faq.question: Is Nova free to use?
faq.answer: Yes. Nova has a free plan for individuals and small teams. You can upgrade whenever you need more features.

faq.question: Can I cancel at any time?
faq.answer: Absolutely. There are no long-term contracts. You can cancel your subscription whenever you want.

faq.question: Does Nova work on mobile?
faq.answer: Yes. The website is fully responsive and works across phones, tablets and desktop devices.

faq.question: Can I invite my team?
faq.answer: Yes. You can invite team members and assign them projects, tasks and permissions.
